mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that directly supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 8.0%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates consumer confidence and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 8.0%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand expansion, which directly drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases when both series rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% and increasing for three consecutive months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising above 0.5% and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which directly supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230, it signals elevated inflation that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 230), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint improvement in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that directly boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% and UNRATE declines by at least 0.1%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO falling below 95), economic activity slows due to manufacturing weakness, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
